entities.name: PMID:27495988
observations: Javle et al. profiled 183 biliary tract cancers treated with gemcitabine plus platinum; combined CDKN2A, TP53, and ARID1A status correlated with progression-free and overall survival, but no single gene independently predicted response.
The study was retrospective and primarily prognostic/hypothesis-generating for chemotherapy resistance.

entities.name: PMID:37139666
observations: Kim et al. analyzed 193 advanced biliary tract cancers by targeted NGS; among 177 patients receiving first-line gemcitabine/cisplatin, ARID1A alteration independently associated with primary resistance or progression (OR 3.12, p=0.046).
External NGS validation and cell-line drug-sensitivity experiments supported an ARID1A-associated cisplatin resistance signal; prospective validation remains needed.

entities.name: PMID:29121415
observations: A phase II targeted-exome study of trametinib in gemcitabine-refractory biliary tract cancer found one prolonged-progression-free patient with ARID1A loss-of-function and NF1 splice-region synonymous variants.
This isolated observation concerns trametinib sensitivity after gemcitabine failure, not proof of cytotoxic chemotherapy resistance.

entities.name: PMID:38967597
observations: Whole-exome sequencing of 52 PSC-associated biliary tract cancers found RTK/RAS, TP53, and PI3K pathway alterations associated with reduced overall survival.
Chemotherapy response or resistance was not tested, so the findings are prognostic/actionability evidence only.

entities.name: Biliary tract cancer
observations: Includes intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, and gallbladder cancer represented in the cited NGS cohorts.

entities.name: ARID1A
observations: Alteration was associated with primary gemcitabine/cisplatin resistance or progression in advanced biliary tract cancer; supportive cisplatin resistance was observed in ARID1A-mutant bile-duct cancer cell lines.
The evidence is gene-level and does not establish a specific recurrent nucleotide or amino-acid variant.

entities.name: CDKN2A
observations: Together with TP53 mutation, identified a particularly poor-outcome group during gemcitabine-platinum treatment in a retrospective biliary tract cancer NGS cohort.

entities.name: TP53
observations: Together with CDKN2A and ARID1A status, contributed to outcome stratification during gemcitabine-platinum treatment in a retrospective biliary tract cancer NGS cohort.

entities.name: Gemcitabine/cisplatin
observations: First-line regimen in the strongest cited study; ARID1A alteration was associated with primary resistance or progression.
